class.name: AgentTest
class.brief_description: Base class for gameplay tests run with [code]--agent-test[/code].
class.description:
Extend this class and add [code]test_*[/code] methods. Each test runs in a fresh scene tree with a fixed time step and random seed, so runs are repeatable. Waits count physics frames and return a [Signal] to [code]await[/code]. A failed assertion records the first failure and its script line; the test keeps running. Input sent, signals received and collisions of tracked bodies go into a trace that is printed when a test fails. [codeblock] extends AgentTest
func test_door_opens() -> void: var level := load_scene("res://level.tscn") track_body(level.get_node("Player")) await press_action("interact") assert_true(await signal_or_timeout(level.get_node("Door"), "opened", 2.0), "door should open") [/codeblock]

method.name: assert_eq
method.description: Fails the test if [param actual] is not equal to [param expected]. The message shows both values.

method.name: assert_false
method.description: Fails the test with [param message] if [param condition] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: assert_near
method.description: Fails the test if [param actual] is further than [param tolerance] from [param expected]. Works with numbers, [Vector2] and [Vector3]; other types are compared with [method assert_eq].

method.name: assert_true
method.description: Fails the test with [param message] if [param condition] is [code]false[/code]. Returns [param condition].

method.name: fail
method.description: Fails the test with [param message].

method.name: get_frame
method.description: Returns the number of physics frames since the test started.

method.name: get_trace
method.description: Returns the trace so far (newest last, at most 200 lines), e.g. to assert that a collision happened.

method.name: hold_action
method.description: Presses the input action [param action] until [method release_action] is called or the test ends.

method.name: hold_key
method.description: Presses the physical key [param key] until [method release_key] is called or the test ends.

method.name: load_scene
method.description: Instantiates the scene at [param path], adds it to the tree and returns its root. It is freed when the test ends.

method.name: physics_frames
method.description: Returns a signal emitted after [param frames] physics frames.

method.name: pick
method.description: Same as [method AgentInspector.pick] for the main window.

method.name: press_action
method.description: Presses the input action [param action] and releases it after [param seconds]. Await the returned signal to continue after the release.

method.name: press_key
method.description: Presses the physical key [param key] (a [enum Key] such as [constant KEY_W]) and releases it after [param seconds]. Use this for games that read keys directly with [method Input.is_physical_key_pressed] instead of input actions. Await the returned signal to continue after the release.

method.name: release_action
method.description: Releases the input action [param action].

method.name: release_key
method.description: Releases the physical key [param key].

method.name: screenshot
method.description: Saves the current frame as [code]<test>_<name>.png[/code] (with a [code].json[/code] of camera info) in the folder given by [code]--screenshot-dir[/code] (default [code]agent_screenshots[/code]) and returns its path. Fails the test if nothing is rendered; run with [code]--offscreen[/code].

method.name: seconds
method.description: Returns a signal emitted after [param seconds] of simulated time, rounded to physics frames.

method.name: signal_or_timeout
method.description: Returns a signal emitted with [code]true[/code] when [param object] emits [param signal], or with [code]false[/code] after [param timeout] seconds.

method.name: trace
method.description: Adds [param text] to the trace, prefixed with the current physics frame.

method.name: track_body
method.description: Records collisions of a [CharacterBody3D] or [CharacterBody2D] in the trace, naming the exact shape node that was hit.
